newsitem.title: USA: NHancement says to acquire Advantis.
newsitem.headline: NHancement says to acquire Advantis.

text.p: NHancement Technologies Inc said on Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Advantis Network & System Sdn Bhd for 530,000 shares of NHancement common stock in a pooling of interests.

NHancement expects the acquisition to be accretive to earnings and to add approximately $6 million to revenues in 1997, which would represent a substantial increase over NHancement's 1996 revenues of $3.9 million.
Under the terms of the agreement, 50 percent of the shares are restricted from sale until until August 1998 and the remainder until February 1999.
Esmond Goei, chief executive of NHancement, said, he expedts this acquisition will "provide a springboard for future expansion into the surrounding region."

The acquisition is expected to be closed in the third quarter of 1997, subject to satisfactory completion of audits and approval of Malaysian authorities. NHancement intends to operate Advantis as a wholly owned subsidiary.
Advantis is a fast growing voice and data communications and networking systems integrator located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
NHancement sells a diverse mix of products and services that allow organizations to reduce corporate overhead and improve employee productivity.
